note: Predicted note-duration distributions, Phase 18. Explains why MAPS +offset fell while MAESTRO +offset rose: offset_f1 tolerance is max(50ms, 0.2*ref_duration), so the two corpora score offsets in different regimes -- AND ptify genuinely truncates notes.
conclusion: ptify median 0.127s vs bytedance 0.269s vs reference 0.350s: ptify releases notes ~3x too early. For a typical 0.350s note the tolerance is 70ms; bytedance misses by 81ms, ptify by 223ms (3.2x tolerance).
